I didn't log 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply. It doesn't match the Central team's records, so I replied to Tobias in the #central-team thread to check it with him.

What the records show:
- The Affiliate Amendment (signed 2025-10-02, in effect from 2025-10-15) set Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats.
- The 2026 renewal order form (signed 22 Apr 2026, in effect from 1 May 2026) says Agrisupply's seats stay as the amendment set them.
- The account page, last updated 2026-09-15, also says 40.

I asked Tobias whether 382 is a typo or comes from a newer change I don't have, and to point me to it if so. Until he answers, 40 stays the number of record. The reply only gives seat counts and dates, which anyone on the account's team may see. I left out the prices.
